ideas.name: Equity Bond Rebalancing Pressure
ideas.claim: A larger equity overweight in a simulated 60/40 equity–bond portfolio predicts lower S&P 500 futures returns on the following trading day.
ideas.quote: When stocks are overweight, funds sell stocks and buy bonds, leading to a decrease in equity returns of 17 basis points over the next day.
ideas.mechanism: Institutional portfolio rebalancing creates equity selling pressure when equities become overweight relative to bonds.

rules.market: S&P 500 futures and 10-year U.S. Treasury note futures
rules.entry: Not stated for the reported price effect
rules.exit: Not stated for the reported price effect
rules.filters: Threshold signal measures deviation of a simulated 60/40 equity–bond portfolio from its target allocation.

not_stated: Entry and exit execution times for the reported price effect
ideas.claimed_result: A one-standard-deviation increase in the threshold signal was associated with approximately 16 basis points lower equity returns and 4 basis points higher bond returns over the next trading day.
required_data: Daily 10-year U.S. Treasury note futures returns
